claim_text: An unknown party got into staplesprint.ca without permission
summary: Staples Canada told customers that an unknown party gained unauthorized access to its staplesprint.ca website and had access to certain customer personal information.
detail: We could not find the notice on a Staples page. CBC viewed a copy of the email and a Staples spokesperson spoke to CBC; Global News and Les Affaires quote the notice. Staples calls it a 'security incident' and its notice uses the term 'threat actor'.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Three independent outlets report the company's own notice and spokesperson.

claim_text: The access happened between Nov 1 and Nov 5, 2026
summary: Staples says the unauthorized access took place from Nov 1 to Nov 5, 2026.
detail: Staples has not said when it found the access.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The notice's dates are given by all three outlets.

claim_text: Names, emails, addresses, order summaries and encrypted passwords were involved
summary: Staples says the information involved included name, email address, shipping address, billing address, order summary and encrypted password.
detail: 'Encrypted password' is Staples' wording; whether it means a hash is not said. Staples says it believes the risk to customers is low.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Global News and Les Affaires both list these data types from the notice.

claim_text: No financial information was exposed, Staples says
summary: Staples says no financial information was exposed.
detail: This is the company's statement; no outside check has been published.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: All three outlets report the statement.

claim_text: Affected customers will be asked to reset their password
summary: Staples says customers who may be affected will be prompted to reset their password at their next login.
detail: Only Global News reports this part of the notice.
label: Reported

claim_text: Staples' other websites were not affected
summary: A Staples spokesperson told CBC the incident did not affect any of Staples' other websites.
detail: One outlet, quoting a company spokesperson.
label: Reported

claim_text: Staples is investigating the full scope
summary: Staples told CBC a full investigation is under way and it is assessing the full scope. It told customers it would update them as it learns more.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: CBC and Global News both report the investigation and promised update.

summary: Staples has not said how many customers may have been affected.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: CBC says the company did not specify a number.

claim_text: Who was behind it, and how they got in
summary: No attacker has been named and no method has been given. We found no claim of responsibility for this incident.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Neither report says who did it or how.

claim_text: A separate extortion claim against Staples, Inc. (the US company)
summary: In early November, an extortion group reportedly listed Staples, Inc. as a victim on a leak site. Law firms opened investigations on Nov 9 and 10. We did not visit any leak site; we know of the claim only through those notices.
detail: This is a different company and a different website from staplesprint.ca. The claim comes from the group itself, and Staples, Inc. has not confirmed an incident.
label: Unverified
why_it_supports: Both notices relay the group's claim and say the company has not confirmed it.

claim_text: The Canadian print-site breach is linked to the Staples, Inc. claim
summary: No source links the staplesprint.ca breach to the claim against Staples, Inc.
detail: The two have different dates, data and reported details.
label: Not established
why_it_supports: Nothing in either set of sources connects them.
